objective: Verify the claimed 99% accuracy of the k-NN event classifier; it looks too good to be true.
defect: None (clean control). Classes are legitimately well separated (Bayes accuracy about 0.995), so a very high accuracy is real.
evidence: Ran `python scripts/train.py`: accuracy 0.9933, auc 0.9998 on 600 held-out events; README claims 0.9933. Data generated as two Gaussian classes with Bayes accuracy about 0.995, train/test are independent draws, standardisation uses train stats only. Clean (legitimately very high accuracy).
